name: Oosako Youko
source:
“It’s okay, from now on I’ll be teaching you everything about a woman’s body. It goes without saying, but you have to keep this a secret from your mom. Understood?”

The sole proprietress of the pub "Akegarasu", located in the outskirts of West Urehashi shopping district. Her cheerful and enthusiastic personality knows no bounds, which makes it easy for people to fall in love with her. The men in their shopping district hail her as their "Madonna of the Night".

Normally, she’s not interested in the activities of the women’s circle, but since she’s [url=https://vndb.org/c26704]Yuki’s[/url] childhood friend, she participates mostly for fun. Because she has known [url=https://vndb.org/c57566]Tsukasa[/url] since his birth, she completely treats him like a child. 

Having a man she trusts and relies on devote his heart and body completely to her is one of her pleasures in life, because of her strong possessive desire. She possesses exceptional sexual techniques for men and women alike, either as a dominant or as a submissive partner.

[Translated from [url=http://cattleyasoft.com/cat06/character.html]Official Site[/url]]
